units: <cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 6:1">Tam. VI, 1</cite> <he>המ׳</he> the easternmost light on the candle-stick; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מִזְרָחִיִּים</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 6:1">Ib.</cite> <he>שני נרות מ׳</he> (Talm. ed. <he>מערביים</he>) the two easternmost lights.
Gen. R. s. 43, beg. לבם של מ׳ the heart of the eastern kings (Gen. XIV, 1); Yalk. Is. 311 אזרחיים (corr. acc.).—Fem. מִזְרָחִית.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 4:1">Tam. IV, 1</cite> <he>קרן מ׳ צפונית</he> the north-eastern corner of the altar.
